popup.subtitle: Tweets → CSV (in-page capture)
popup.page_hint: : several accounts, the queue and its progress, the cap and the CSVs.
popup.need_dates: Fill in the dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
popup.no_start: Not starting the capture: {error}. Without the service, what X shows wouldn't be counted toward the 24-hour cap.
popup.gate_full: The gate's 24-hour cap is full, so I'm not starting the capture. Try again later.
popup.already_done: Everything in that range is already captured ({count} tweets in the CSV). It's on xport's page.
popup.opening: Opening the search and scrolling… (you can close the popup)
popup.queued: Queued: it starts when the current capture finishes. xport's page shows the progress.
popup.stopped_no_scroll: Capture stopped (nothing was scrolling in this tab).
popup.excluded: {count} replies to other accounts are left out (the CSV has the account's own tweets and threads).
popup.reset_needs_account: Fill in the account (without @) to delete what was captured.
popup.reset_confirm: Delete everything captured for @{account}? You'll have to capture the range again. (It doesn't affect the 24-hour gate.)
popup.reset_done: Deleted {count} tweets from @{account}. The next capture starts from scratch.
error.offline: couldn't reach the service at {base} (is it running?)
notice.resuming: Resuming @{account} from {from} (you already had {count} tweets)… (you can close the popup)
notice.paused: The capture of @{account} is paused because its tab is hidden. Go back to that tab so it keeps going.
notice.waiting: X paused the search for a while: the capture of @{account} waits until {time} and carries on by itself.
note.stop_cap: The gate's 24-hour cap filled up, so I stopped the capture. You can carry on once the oldest accesses leave the window (the popup shows how many are left).
note.stop_offline: The local service isn't answering at {base}, so I stopped the capture rather than see tweets the 24-hour cap can't count. Start the service and capture again.
note.stop_rejected: The service rejected the capture ({status}), so I stopped it. Check the service log.
note.stop_format: x.com changed the shape of its data and xport needs an update. I stopped the capture so it wouldn't carry on into an empty CSV; the service log has an example.
note.stopped_popup: You stopped it from the popup.
note.reset_popup: You deleted what was captured from the popup.
